name: Hildegard Bentele - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the future of the EU biotechnology and biomanufacturing sector: leveraging research, boosting innovation and enhancing competitiveness
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to make the EU a world leader in biotechnology and biomanufacturing — using living organisms to make medicines, chemicals, materials and food. It wants faster approval procedures, simpler rules, more money for research, and a clear definition of biomanufacturing. It also wants a new EU law on biotechnology, an updated bioeconomy strategy, better protection of intellectual property, and action on biosecurity risks. This is an opinion; it does not change any law itself.

- The report asks the Commission for faster approvals, simpler rules and a new EU biotech law.
- It affects biotech and biomanufacturing companies, researchers, investors, farmers and patients.
- Next, the Commission decides whether to propose laws; Parliament's request is not binding.
